steps.description: Using the raw count matrix and metadata, pre-filter to genes with at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size). Build a DESeqDataSet with design ~ condition, explicitly set 'control' as the reference level, and run the Wald test. Do not pre-normalize the counts — DESeq2's internal median-of-ratios size factors absorb sample_01's lower depth. Keep DESeq2's default count-outlier handling (Cook's-distance-based NA flagging for cells with <7 replicates) and report the number of genes flagged. Apply apeglm shrinkage to the treated-vs-control log2 fold change (coefficient-based shrinkage since this is a single two-level factor). Extract results with BH-adjusted p-values and independent filtering at alpha=0.05. Inspect and report the raw p-value histogram shape before trusting the adjusted values. Report both the unshrunken and apeglm-shrunken log2FC with the standard error, and rank/report genes by the shrunken LFC and by the Wald statistic. Produce MA plot and dispersion plot as fit diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: DESeqDataSet built with explicit reference level = control and design ~ condition
Pre-filter reports number of genes retained (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) out of the 12000 gene input
Wald test results include unshrunken log2FC, apeglm-shrunken log2FC, lfcSE, p-value, and BH-adjusted p-value (padj) per gene
Number of genes with padj < 0.05 reported, plus number of NA-p-value genes from count-outlier flagging reported separately from independent-filtering NAs
p-value histogram, MA plot, and dispersion plot produced

plan.title: Heart treated vs control DE + pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 heart samples (6 treated, 6 control), unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples after excluding metadata header). Total-RNA rRNA-depleted libraries without UMIs, with QC flagging >60% duplication in most libraries and sample_01 at ~4x below median library size. The plan follows the grounded DESeq2 procedure end to end: (1) sample-structure QC that explicitly surfaces the low-depth sample and the duplication rate rather than silently dropping/deduplicating anything (duplication in RNA-seq tracks expression level and must not be removed without UMIs); (2) minimal count pre-filtering and DESeq2's internal median-of-ratios normalization, which absorbs the depth difference of sample_01 through its size factor rather than requiring removal; (3) an explicit-reference-level design (control as reference) with a Wald test and apeglm shrinkage for the treated-vs-control contrast; (4) BH-adjusted results with independent filtering at alpha 0.05, inspecting the p-value histogram before trusting the adjustment; (5) pathway interpretation via over-representation analysis (ORA) against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome human sets restricted to an explicit tested-gene universe, per the knowledge-service check (fgsea preranked GSEA was flagged as not permitted for this situation profile — ORA with an explicit universe is the checked, permitted method here); (6) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics, effect-size and QC caveats, and a full reproducibility record. No batch correction is applied (single batch, unpaired, no covariates in the metadata).
